hint.text: Commas are used to separate fronted adverbial phrases from the rest of the sentence. There should be a comma placed after the fronted adverbial.

instruction.text: Rearrange the sentence so that the adverbial phrase is at the start.

atoms.a: I do my homework after school.
I was determined to win the race from the start.
The downpour stopped as suddenly as it had started.
The teachers are very strict at my school.
There is lots of wildlife under the sea.

instruction.text: Read the text and drag the punctuation to the correct places.

atoms.sound: As soon as I wake up, I stretch and do some yoga.
atoms.b: As soon as I wake up((,)) I stretch and do some yoga((.))

atoms.sound: On my birthday, I eat cake for breakfast.
atoms.b: On my birthday((,)) I eat cake for breakfast((.))

atoms.sound: During the winter, it is more likely to snow.
atoms.b: During the winter((,)) it is more likely to snow((.))

atoms.sound: Once a week, I babysit for my neighbours.
